text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Score, that's one point!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
3-0!
Heheh, come on now, Scarlet, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...!
Jeez, Fine-san, since when were you this good!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
What do you mean, what?... A one-on-one futsal match.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "...I was feeling a bit down earlier, you see. My test score wasn't great. But then—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
...Aargh, seriously..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...A sigh.
Did something happen?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Scarlet-chan!
Wanna play a quick game before training?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? A game?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "That's right, you kick the ball and bring it all the way to the goal! If you score, that's one point!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, in other words, futsal~!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
F-Futsal!?
Me and Fine-san? B-But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it fine every now and then?
I can be the referee, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Or something like that?
Man, it kicked off before I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So I just figured
I'd wrap it up with a quick win, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Fine-san is
somehow pretty strong...!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What's the matter? Giving up already~? Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Look at that relaxed face.
Aaah, now I'm getting fired up!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely going to score a point!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah!
Now this... is serious, isn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Taaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... gh!
All right!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I feel like I was so close
to cutting it off, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Scarlet's acceleration was incredible.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun.
Don't you dare underestimate me when I'm serious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her gloomy look vanished without a trace...
and Daiwa Scarlet went on to enjoy playing futsal for quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... gh!
Ngh, man, and I was so close too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've started to get the hang of it.
If so, I'm sure... I can do this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet continued to enjoy playing futsal to her heart's content after that.
